ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: Lying on the beach at night, a villager notices that the stars have moved: stay up and watch, or tell a friend.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Lying on the beach one night, (subject) notices a bright star just above a palm tree. Much later, (subject.he/she) looks again. The star has moved. In fact, all of them have moved, slowly, together, as though the whole sky is turning around one point.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) stays awake almost all night, marking the stars against the trees. By dawn (subject.he/she) is certain: they go round, all of them, except one small star that barely moves at all. Why that one? (subject.He/She) falls asleep on the sand before (subject.he/she) can decide, and wakes up with a crab on (subject.his/her) foot.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (friend) listens, then asks the obvious question: "Is the sky going round, or are we?" (subject) opens (subject.his/her) mouth and closes it again. Neither of them can say. It's a strange, dizzy thought, and they both hold on to the nearest tree trunk for a moment, just in case.
